title: A model training method and system based on federated learning
assignee: Guangdong Provincial Laboratory Of Artificial Intelligence And Digital Economy Shenzhen

pse.problem: Model training inefficiency and instability in federated learning scenarios with heterogeneous data distribution
pse.solution_function: The system performs federated learning by dividing the target dataset into sub-training sets for each client, conducting gradient update training on feature extraction and recognition layers, and aggregating selected layer parameters to the central server for average calculation to improve precision, accuracy, and convergence.
pse.solution_structure: Central Server: manages client set, controls data distribution, aggregates layer parameters. Basic Clients: perform gradient update training on feature extraction and recognition layers, send updated parameters to the central server.
pse.solution_implementation: Central Server: initiates the training round, determines data category amounts for clients, creates sub-training sets, distributes basic neural network and sub-training sets to clients. Clients: perform gradient update training on assigned sub-training set, send updated layer parameters to central server.
pse.effect: Improved precision, accuracy, and convergence of federated learning models in heterogeneous data environments
